operating_notes.text: March 2026 alone contributed ₹257.17 Cr of FY26 revenue of ₹531 Cr, which the filing links to higher receivables and debtor days.
Order book stood at over ₹950 Cr including BESS-related opportunities, with active bidding pipeline of ₹1,240+ Cr.
Aarsh Transformers is being expanded to 7.5 MVA capacity after type-testing up to 500 kVA.
NSE Main Board listing covers 1,01,24,800 equity shares of ₹10 each, ISIN INE0MEG01014, with a market lot of 1.
Board decided not to proceed with proposed preferential warrant issue.

timeline.summary: Viviana Power Tech board approved raising up to ₹75 Cr via NCDs at 12% coupon.
Viviana Power Tech allotted ₹20 Cr in senior secured NCDs at a 12% coupon rate maturing in May 2028.
Viviana Power Tech received NSE in-principle approval to migrate its equity shares from the SME platform to the Main Board.

Viviana Power reported FY26 consolidated revenue of ₹531.25 Cr (up 143%) and net profit of ₹52.73 Cr (up 167%), and its board approved a ₹100 Cr greenfield transformer plant near Vadodara targeting production by end-2HFY28.
Board of Directors, chaired by Kavaljit Nishant Parmar, recommended ₹1 dividend per equity share for FY 2025-26 on May 25, 2026.
Viviana Power Tech received final NSE listing and trading approval to migrate from the SME EMERGE platform to the NSE Main Board, effective June 02, 2026.
Viviana Power Tech announced its decision not to proceed with the preferential warrant issue on October 15, 2026.
